title: Concrete open comparison models with shift identities
statement: For every inverse coefficient-ring sequence C, τ and every pair of composable open immersions s:U→V and b:V→X, the specified structure OpenModels C τ s b is nonempty. Its witness is built from the canonical ordinary extension compositor, ordinary normalized open restriction, their exact-derived representatives, and their proved adjunct, normalization and shift equations. There are no boundedness or coefficient-flatness assumptions.

proof.text: Use the existing additive exact ordinary open functors. Define the ordinary compositor by leftAdjointCompIso and the restriction by its inverse followed by the inverse open unit. The adjunction conjugacy unit identity proves both normalization formulas. Apply derivedMate_comparison with the exact-derived hom-equivalence factorization to identify the localized compositor and inverse restriction with the specified jComp and restrictionIso. All representatives are actual natural transformations of whole systems.

proof.text: The ordinary and derived compositor and restriction identities from the first step, their termwise shift squares, and the exact-derived open adjunction shift identity give every field of OpenModels. Assemble the original concrete structure literal; this proves Nonempty (OpenModels C τ s b), including for identity and empty opens. The remaining direct-image/projector and identity calculations in this support file are the unchanged proofs used by the final clopen model.
